name: 광마회귀
voice_summary: Dry, laconic, and deeply ironic interior monologue from a protagonist who performs nonchalance as armor. The rhythm alternates between terse, punchy self-commentary ('그런 편이지요') and sudden bursts of absurdist logic. The narrator editorializes constantly—self-deprecating yet quietly proud—and the voice is tonally flat precisely when events are most dramatic, creating comedic friction. Chapters are titled like episode headings or meme captions, functioning as micro-punchlines that reframe the chapter's content ironically before it even begins.
